events.verdict: Arcidiacono (CHI) makes marginal contact with DeRozan's (SAS) arm during his drive but it does not affect his SQBR.
Markkanen (CHI) makes clean hand on ball contact during DeRozan's (SAS)drive shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (CHI) makes contact with Aldridge's (SAS) body and affects his driving shot attempt.
Markkanen (CHI) makes marginal contact with Belinelli (SAS) arm during the screen but he is able to move through contact.
Belinelli (SAS) makes marginal contact with Portis's (CHI) arm but does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Aldridge (SAS) slightly extends his arm against Dunn's (CHI) shoulder during the pick but he is able to move through the contact.
Portis (CHI) makes incidental contact with Belinelli's (SAS) leg during the pass.
Aldridge (SAS) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
LLB shows Holiday (CHI) makes some contact with Gay's (SAS) arm during the rebound but he is able to retrieve the ball.
Portis (CHI) makes contact with Gay (SAS)'s arm during the follow-through on his shot near the rim and does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
Portis (CHI) makes marginal contact with DeRozan's (SAS) side during the pick but he is able to move through the contact.
Holiday (CHI) briefly grasps DeRozan's (SAS) arm but doesn't affect his ability to get to the pass.
Holiday (CHI) makes marginal contact with DeRozan (SAS)'s body but does not affect his shot attempt near the rim.
Gay (SAS) puts two hands against Markkanen's (CHI) side prior to the pick but he is able to move through the contact.
Aldridge (SAS) sets the screen in Arcidiacono's (CHI) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Aldridge (SAS) commits a take foul on Dunn (CHI).
